phone.notes: New: equipment for your Digimon (weapon, armor, shield, shoes, helmet), potential with Glitches (up to 3 lines per piece, Rare to Legendary), merge Digi-Beetle parts, sell all of it in shops, Domains and Digi-Beetle in the menu, a portal icon with the time left, and Digimon that run and train on the farm. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: Fix: the steps of an adventure count again. The walk could stay at 0 / 1000 while encounters kept coming, because it used a rough accelerometer guess if you started it right after opening the app. It now always uses the step counter of the watch.
